title: Minimal OneBot platform adapter
objective: Add the first real platform adapter behind PlatformRegistry while keeping network transport deferred.

steps.description: Study AstrBot aiocqhttp registry and private/group message conversion boundaries.
Register ONEBOT_PLATFORM_TYPE and expose OneBotPlatform through PlatformManager.
Normalize private and group text inputs into MessageEvent with typed session kind and recording sink.
Add platform and runtime tests proving OneBot events enter the default pipeline.
Run formatting, workspace tests, clippy, and CLI smoke verification.
